meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 扫描当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR,逐个在后台分析并分类,把带证据链接的报告写到 /tmp 里带时间戳的文件夹。它全程只读:不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签,只产出报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等词时,它会开始执行只读分析与写报告。

say.text: 帮我 triage 一下这个仓库。
say.note: 所有未关闭 issue 和 PR 会被逐个分析并出报告。

say.text: 只 triage issues,不要动任何东西。
say.note: 逐个分析未关闭 issue,只在本地写报告。

say.text: 帮我 triage 一下当前的 PR。
say.note: 每个 PR 会生成一份只读分析报告。

howto.what_en: Reads every open issue and PR in the repo, analyzes each in a background subagent, classifies it, and writes reports with permalink evidence to a timestamped /tmp folder. It is read-only: no comments, merges, closes, or edits on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “triage”, “triage issues”, “triage PRs”, or similar triage asks.

say_en.text: Run a triage on this repo.
say_en.note: All open issues and PRs are analyzed into reports.

say_en.text: Triage only the issues, don’t touch anything.
say_en.note: Each open issue is analyzed; reports are written locally.

say_en.text: Triage the current PRs for me.
say_en.note: Each PR gets a read-only analysis report.
